query: How much of this area flooded during the 2024 monsoon (June to September)? How many buildings were affected?
note: Rule 12: a season is a start/end window for map_flood; optical indices and JRC history are not a flood answer.

query: Map the flood extent between 10 May 2024 and 24 June 2024.
note: Explicit dates go to before/after.

query: Which buildings were hit by the June 2024 flood?
Has permanent water in this area changed since 1990? Show flood frequency over the decades.
note: Occurrence history is fetch_surface_water (Rule 11), not a Sentinel-1 flood map.

query: Show me NDVI for this area.
What is the NDWI here?
note: A named index with no colormap, date or sensor is compute_spectral_index.

query: Compute the normalized burn ratio for this area.
Show NDWI with the magma colormap.
note: Rule 17: a colormap request is render_raster with the index as an expression.

query: Is this month's vegetation greener or browner than normal for the time of year?
Give me a true colour picture of this area.
Show the NIR band.
note: NIR, not NDVI: never substitute another product.

query: Display band B05 over my area.
Show the shortwave infrared band 12.
Show the Landsat shortwave infrared 1 band.
Make a false colour composite with near infrared, red and green.
I want a SWIR composite.
Give me a cloud-free median NDVI composite for June to August 2026.
note: A window of weeks or months is the composite operation, never 'on <date>'.

query: Show a cloud-free true colour image of this area, built from the last three months.
What was the average NDVI over the 2025 growing season, April to September?
Claim to check: "Over 20% of the tree cover in this area was lost between 2020 and 2023." Is that supported by the data?
note: A claim is measured, not judged from memory.

query: Claim: this area has received less rain than its 30-year average over the last year. True?
Someone says more than 60% of this area is built up. Is that right?
Claim to check: "Over 20% of the tree cover in this area was lost between 2020 and 2023." Is that supported by the data?
note: The question states a period. Every time-bound step must read inside 2020-2023 (explicit dates) and the plan must pass the period check; a step left on its default latest-imagery window tests another period (live defect, 2026-10-14: detect_deforestation ran on 2025-2026).

query: Did the forest in this area shrink between 2018 and 2021?
note: Same period rule on a plain question rather than a claim: dates inside 2018-2021, not the latest imagery.

query: Show me band B99 of the latest Sentinel-2 image of this area.
note: No such band: relay the refusal, never approximate.

query: Show me Sentinel-2 band B13.
note: Sentinel-2 has no B13.

query: Run a variogram of NDVI with a 5 metre lag.
note: Below the 10 m pixel size.

query: Count the individual cars parked in this area.
note: Not resolvable at 10 m; the honest alternative is what OSM records.

query: Show the NIR band for next month.
note: Next month is after today: no scene exists.

query: Show the NDVI as of 15 March 2027.
Show me Sentinel-2 imagery of this place from the summer of 1995.
note: Sentinel-2 starts in 2015; Landsat is the honest alternative.

query: What was the exact wheat yield in tonnes for the fields in this area last year?
note: No tool measures yield; a dataset search is an honest redirect.

query: Exactly how many people live in this area?
Which tree species grow here?
note: 10 m data gives functional type, never species.

query: Show all the buildings in this area.
How many hospitals and schools are mapped here?
Show the buildings in 3D with their heights.
What is the elevation range here?
How steep is the ground? Is it buildable?
Draw 10 metre contour lines.
How much rain fell here over the last year, and what was the temperature like?
Is the rainy season here getting drier over the decades?
What will the weather be like here tomorrow?
note: No tool reports forecasts or live weather.

query: What is the mean NDVI of this area?
note: The Layer Manifest already holds the figure (Rule 4).

query: Who won the 2018 football World Cup and what is the capital of Australia?
note: Off-topic: decline briefly and say what Erdfeld AI can do; no tool, no answer from memory.

query: Write me a Python function that sorts a list.
What were the daily maximum temperatures here in July 2023, and how many days exceeded 30 C?
note: A past period: fetch_weather_history with start/end, not the trailing year.
